salt-grain.name: klayout-power-pcells
salt-grain.title: Hybrid-waffle power MOSFET PCell for sky130A, drawn from Magic's devices
salt-grain.doc: The sky130_power library: HW_FET, a hybrid-waffle power MOSFET (after Yoo et al., ISPSD 2008) for sky130A whose transistors, vias, taps and wells are drawn by Magic's own generators. Nine MOSFETs (1.8 V nfet/pfet incl. lvt and hvt, 3.3 V and 5 V thick-oxide), a tap ring or a tap in every source tile, met3-met5 diagonal straps. Includes klayout-magic-pcells 0.5.0 (the sky130_magic, gf180mcu_magic, sg13g2_magic and sg13cmos5l_magic libraries), which HW_FET draws through. Needs Magic and sky130A. Install this package instead of klayout-magic-pcells, not next to it.
